accueil.titre: Find your team, build your project, put it online.
accueil.texte: The platform for African developers: help each other, deliver for small businesses, and keep your projects online.
accueil.rassurance: Free. Your profile stays private until you publish it.
accueil.piliers: What you can do on Jamii

profil.texte: Your repositories, your live projects and what your teammates say. No CV.

equipe.texte: Ask questions, help others, find teammates.

enLigne.texte: Jamii checks that it responds and shows it in the showcase.

principe.texte: On Jamii, orange always means the same thing: it is proven. A project that responds, a task delivered on time, an answer accepted by the person who asked.

profil.vide: Your profile will fill up with your public GitHub languages and projects, and the projects you put online on Jamii.

generation.texte: Jamii reads your public repositories (languages, topics, stars) to fill in your profile. Nothing private is read, and you can complete everything afterwards.
generation.prive: Your profile stays private until you publish it.
generation.sansGithub: Your account is not linked to GitHub. Sign in with GitHub to generate your profile.
generation.tropSouvent: You have already updated your profile several times this hour. Try again a little later.

erreurs.github_indisponible: GitHub is not responding right now. Your previous profile is kept: try again in a few minutes.
erreurs.github_refus: GitHub can no longer find your account. Check your GitHub username, then try again.

lu.langages: Your languages, measured on your public repositories

visibilite.prive: 🔒 Your profile is private: only you can see it.
visibilite.publie: ✅ Your profile is published: signed-in members can see it and invite you to a team.

modifier.competencesAide: Separated by commas, 20 at most. Example: UX design, Mobile Money
modifier.conflit: Your profile changed in another tab. Here is the latest version: please make your change again.

langages.estimation: Estimated from the size of your public GitHub repositories (forks excluded).

competences.source: Deduced from your GitHub repositories, plus the ones you add.

projets.vide: No project yet. The projects you put online with your team will appear here, with the verified link.

depots.pasUnePreuve: Repositories show what you code. Only a project that is online and verified counts as proof.

types.tache_livree_a_temps: task delivered on the planned date | tasks delivered on the planned date
types.avis_coequipier: positive teammate review | positive teammate reviews
types.projet_en_ligne: verified project online | verified projects online

fiabilite.contestees: including {n} being checked | including {n} being checked
fiabilite.vide: No proof yet. It adds up on its own as you take part:

comment.projet_en_ligne: a project put online with your team, that responds;
comment.tache_livree_a_temps: a task delivered on the planned date;
comment.reponse_acceptee: an answer accepted in a community;
comment.avis_coequipier: a teammate who would work with you again.

fiabilite.sansNote: No overall score: each point can be checked, and disputed if it is wrong.

etat.indisponible: Jamii is not responding right now. Try again in a moment.

introuvable.texte: The address may be mistyped, or the page has moved.

systalink.intro: What Jamii brings to the Systalink cloud. Figures are aggregated and anonymous: no individual appears.
systalink.partDatacloud: {part}% of online projects are hosted on DataCloud
systalink.seuilPays: A country appears once it has 5 members, so that no one can be identified.

cercles.intro: Circles of 4 to 6 developers build each member's project, one turn at a time. Every delivered turn is a project completed as a team.
cercles.termines: no circle completed | 1 circle completed | {n} circles completed

systalink.momentsIntro: Jamii offers a Systalink service at the right moment: DataCloud to put a project online, Orion for a small business website… Here is how often, and how many people followed it.
systalink.momentsVide: No service offered in this period.
systalink.nonMesure: Moving to a paid plan is not measured: Jamii cannot see purchases made at Systalink.

vitrine.intro: Projects born on Jamii and actually online. Every address responded less than 24 hours ago.

communautes.intro: Ask questions, help others and show your projects, with developers from across the continent.
communautes.questionsOuvertes: no open question | {n} open question | {n} open questions
communautes.aideIa: For a question, the AI will suggest an answer. A community member will have to check it.
communautes.erreurPublier: Your post could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
communautes.rejoindrePourPublier: Join the community to post and answer.
communautes.vide: Nothing here yet. Ask the first question!

fonctionnement.poser: You ask the community your question.
fonctionnement.ia: The AI suggests a first answer, marked “to be checked”. It does not count on anyone’s profile.
fonctionnement.accepter: A member checks it or answers better. You accept the best answer: it counts on its author’s profile.

espace.invite: Ask a question or start a discussion…

question.iaPrepare: The AI is preparing an answer…
question.iaIndisponible: The AI did not suggest an answer. Community members can answer.
question.proposeeParIa: Suggested by the AI · to be checked by a peer
question.attendUnPair: Another community member must check this answer.
question.merciValidation: Thank you! Your check makes this answer reliable for everyone.
question.merciAcceptation: 🎉 Answer accepted. It now appears on its author’s profile.

erreurs.pas_membre: Join the community to do this.
erreurs.pas_auteur_question: Only the author of the question can accept an answer.
erreurs.propre_question: You cannot confirm the answer to your own question: another member must do it.
erreurs.deja_acceptee: This question already has an accepted answer.
erreurs.propre_reponse: You cannot accept your own answer: only help from another member counts on a profile.
erreurs.proposee_par_ia: The AI answer cannot be accepted: another member has to check it.
erreurs.autre: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

designSystem.intro: Jamii's visual identity, as the app uses it. Every colour comes from docs/design/tokens.json, and contrasts are computed live.
designSystem.marqueAide: A brand only changes the action colour. The orange used for proof stays the same everywhere.
designSystem.contrastesAide: Measured on the theme and brand shown. WCAG 2.1 AA thresholds: 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for borders and focus.

exemples.iaTexte: Dashed until a human accepts it: it is not proof yet.

pied.mission: The exchange platform for African developers: help each other, team up and put your projects online.
pied.cadev: Project presented at CADEV 2026. Jamii runs on the Systalink cloud.

signaler.merci: Thanks, a moderator will look at it.
signaler.erreur: The report could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

nouvelle.intro: Explain in your own words what your business needs. The assistant turns it into a clear plan, then a team of developers can build it.
nouvelle.champTitre: In one sentence, what do you need?
nouvelle.aideTitre: For example: an online shop for my workshop.
nouvelle.champDescription: Tell us: who will use it, what it must do, what matters to you
nouvelle.aideDescription: At least {n} characters. No technical words needed.
nouvelle.duree: How soon would you like it?
nouvelle.rassurance: Free. Nothing is published without your agreement.
nouvelle.erreur: Your request could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
nouvelle.ensuite1: The assistant suggests a plan: what to do, how long it takes, and with whom.
nouvelle.ensuite2: You read it. Nothing is decided without you.
nouvelle.ensuite3: A team of Jamii developers takes the project and puts it online.

exemples.titre: An online shop for my sewing workshop
exemples.description: I sew clothes in Thiès. I want to show my designs with their prices, receive orders on WhatsApp and get paid by Mobile Money.
We are 30 women in a savings group. We want to see who has paid and everyone’s turn from a basic phone.
My patients call all day long. I want them to pick a slot online and get an SMS reminder the day before.

plan.prepare: The assistant is preparing your plan…
plan.prepareAide: It reads your request and splits it into steps. This takes a few seconds.
plan.echec: The plan could not be prepared.
plan.echecAide: Your request is saved. Try again in a moment.
plan.propose: Plan suggested by the assistant · to read, nothing is decided
plan.repli: The assistant was not available: here is a plan template to complete with the team.
plan.rolesAide: These roles will be offered to Jamii developers.
plan.servicesAide: Suggestions, never an obligation: the plan works without them.
plan.decision: Happy with this plan? A team can form around it.
plan.lancer: Start the project with this plan
plan.lance: Project started. The roles to find are offered to developers.
plan.dejaPrise: A team has already started a project on this request.
plan.erreurLancement: The project could not be started. Try again in a moment.

cercles.intro: 4 to 6 developers build each member's project, one turn at a time. Systalink guarantees the circle.
cercles.joursRestants: last day | 1 day left | {n} days left
cercles.avantTirage: The turn order has not been drawn yet.
cercles.avantTirageAide: The circle is full. | 1 more member is needed. | {n} more members are needed.
cercles.ideeTitre: The project you want to see built
cercles.ideeAide: Who it is for and what it should do. The circle builds it during your turn.
cercles.tirageAide: Possible once the circle is full and everyone has shared an idea. The server draws the order once.

erreurs.deja_membre: You are already in this circle.
erreurs.tirage_deja_fait: The order has already been drawn.
erreurs.idees_manquantes: Every member must share an idea first.
erreurs.autre: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
erreurs.tour_non_en_cours: This turn is no longer in progress.

nouveau.intro: You will be its first member. Others join, everyone shares an idea, then you draw the turn order.
nouveau.tailleAide: {n} two-week turns: everyone gets their project built.

cercles.livrerConfirmation: Is {nom}'s project finished? It is handed over to {nom}, and {suivant}'s turn begins.
cercles.livrerDernier: Is {nom}'s project finished? This is the last turn: the circle will be finished.
cercles.livreTexte: It will appear in the showcase once it is online, with its team's name.
cercles.termineAide: {n} projects delivered, one per member. The circle can start a new round.
cercles.pointTexte: Day {jour} of {nom}'s turn: {faites} of {total} tasks delivered.

vide.mes: You are not part of a circle yet.
vide.ouverts: No circle is looking for members right now. Create yours.

pourToi.aide: Picked from your skills and your city.

raisonsProfil.presque_complet: The circle needs only one more person

profils.aide: Available developers who bring what the circle doesn't have yet: {competences}.
profils.vide: No available profile matches yet. Share the circle's link in a community.
profils.messageParDefaut: Hi {nom}, our “{cercle}” is looking for someone who knows {competences}. Would you like to join us?
profils.envoye: Invitation sent. {nom} will see it in their messages.

erreurs.cercle_ferme: The circle is full, or the order has already been drawn.
erreurs.pas_membre_du_cercle: Only members of the circle can invite.
erreurs.autre: The invitation wasn't sent. Try again.
